## Focus

AI systems (agents, retrieval, LLM pipelines, evals). Automation (n8n, webhooks, API integrations, human-in-the-loop). Product engineering (Next.js, TypeScript, backend, PostgreSQL). Distributed ledgers (Daml on Canton). Taking an idea from a paragraph to a running system.

## Selected work

- Tenzro Network (2025 to now): distributed ledger infrastructure and self-custody wallets on the Canton privacy-preserving network. Contract layer in Daml. Stack: Daml, Canton, TypeScript, Node.js.
- Kolfly (2025): multi-tenant AI SaaS for influencer marketing, from discovery to billing, with AI-assisted campaign strategy and usage-based billing. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, LLM pipelines, PostgreSQL, Stripe.
- AI Tutor (2025): an LLM classroom tutor with three avatar modes, built as the usable artifact for a research study. Stack: Python, LLM orchestration, real-time avatars, WebRTC.
- AI Website Redesign Pipeline (2025): a human-in-the-loop pipeline that scrapes a site, generates redesigns and exports a deployable Next.js project. Runs entirely local. Stack: Next.js 15, Playwright, Claude API, TypeScript.
- WMTI (2026): a Turborepo monorepo running three services in three languages behind one shared type contract. Stack: Turborepo, React 19, Go / Fiber / gRPC, FastAPI, ChromaDB, Cloudflare.
- Canton Experiments (2025): a library of self-contained Daml contracts, each isolating one distributed-ledger pattern. Stack: Daml, Canton 3.
